screening.note: c6-contiki (and c6-hello where given), 5 s, one run per arm per round, in the order listed; host instructions retired; every run had the base's stop line and console. A: underflow fix + LEDC has_deadline = a fade runs, its deadline #[cold] out of line. B: A + two-pass optional_deadline in device_set!. C: B + tick_unit field. C-nopcnt: C without the C6 PCNT table entry (attribution only). D: C + C6 PCNT as a static entry. final: D + the PCNT SIG_IN_SEL change (cold path only).

limits: One machine, native only, heavily loaded (CPU time not usable; host instructions are load-independent to about +-0.1% between paired runs, and drift by up to 0.4% across a 5-run arm). The base tree's path differs in length from the candidate's (debug info only). No CPU-time claim.
